name: forecast.cashflows
summary: Native account forecast output points by target time and model.
purpose: Inspect native forecast amounts without confusing creation/update time with future target time.

list.description: Read one account/currency/entity and explicit target date range.

limitations: GET /queryCashFlowData.json once with exact JSON-string cashFlowDataQueryVO. Required account/currency/date range; entity defaults to Z21, explicit entity is preserved. No amount filters, timezone conversion or pagination invented.

Both native actutalRecordNum and currentRecordNum must equal response arrivals before accepting this unpaged response. Unknown reported total remains null in SDK evidence; failed or mismatched count witnesses reject the candidate.

Internal typed-tuple SHA-256 includes all13 approved dimensions, including gmtCreate. Empty strings and explicit null are meaningful components; missing fields remain errors. No synthetic business ID is added.
Amounts and gmtModified are mutable values, excluded from identity. Same-key duplicates retain diagnostics and conservative publication policy; conflicting values are not silently declared complete.

Null gmtCreate means no valid forecast value exists yet, even if amount is present. Retain that point and raw amounts, nulls and all unknown/nested fields without manufacturing a valid flag or dropping it.
Empty timeZone has owner-confirmed UTC+8 business meaning; raw JSON stays empty. Millisecond timestamps stay native because general SDK currently has no declarative time formatting.

Complete nonempty refresh publishes; offline replays its own saved scope. Live does not publish and failed/empty refresh preserves the prior capture. No legacy runtime. Durable publication requires explicit sync.

examples.title: Read native forecast points
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity list forecast.cashflows --live --account-alias ACCOUNT --currency USD --inst-id ENTITY --from-date 20261015 --to-date 20261015 --require-complete --limit 0

sync.evidence: Owner-approved full business dimensions plus native gmtCreate distinguish coexisting forecast models. Null creation means no valid forecast so far, retained unchanged. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.

time.basis: Inclusive native forecast target day YYYYMMDD.
